focus: I study how to make deployed AI systems reliable across long conversations, shifting user intent, and real-world constraints. My work spans agent post-training, evaluations designed with domain experts, instruction following, and test-time monitoring, with applications in reproductive health, wildlife conservation, and road safety.
researchAreas: Post-training environments that teach agents to clarify intent, recover, abstain, or delegate.
Contextual evaluations built with domain experts rather than proxy metrics alone.
Understanding and improving agents' instruction-following behavior.
Monitoring deployed systems at test time.
